Class IntellijTextResourceWriteRenderer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.ui.IntellijTextResourceWriteRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<AbstractTextResourceWrite>
public class IntellijTextResourceWriteRenderer extends Object implements ParameterRenderer<AbstractTextResourceWrite>
IntelliJ diff renderer for any AbstractTextResourceWrite tool-call argument (full-file updates, replacements, line edits).

This is the IntelliJ counterpart of the NetBeans AbstractTextResourceWriteRenderer: it computes the proposed content by applying the tool's structured edits in-memory to the real file, then shows an editable side-by-side diff (current-on-disk vs proposed) using the platform DiffRequestPanel. While the tool call is PENDING, edits the user makes to the proposed pane are written back into the tool call via AbstractToolCall.setModifiedArgument(String, Object) (using a Kryo-cloned DTO carrying a manualOverride), so the human can refine the AI's proposal before approving.

A single instance of this renderer is registered for each concrete write DTO type in IntellijAsiContainer; the framework instantiates it per parameter via its public no-arg constructor and drives it through init(AgiPanel, AbstractToolCall, String, AbstractTextResourceWrite)/render()/updateContent(AbstractTextResourceWrite).

    • addGutterComments

      private void addGutterComments(com.intellij.openapi.project.Project project, com.intellij.diff.contents.DocumentContent content)
      Paints the AI's per-line commentary as gutter icons on the proposed pane.

      Markers are added to the document-level markup model, so they appear in the diff viewer's proposed editor; hovering a marker shows the comment. Only FullTextResourceUpdate currently carries line comments; other write types add none.

      Parameters:
      project - the host project.
      content - the proposed document content.
